```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num FROM (
        SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn
        FROM inventories
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
explode AS (
    SELECT ci.id AS inv_id, ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ci.set_num = '70222-1' AND ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ci.id, e.part_num, e.qty * x.quantity
    FROM explode e
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = (
        SELECT set_num FROM inventory_sets WHERE inventory_id = e.inv_id
    )
    JOIN inventory_sets x ON x.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    WHERE false
)
SELECT 1;
```

```sql
    SELECT i.set_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS v FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num) m
      ON i.set_num = m.set_num AND i.version = m.v
),
-- current inventory per minifig
fig_inv AS (
    SELECT i.set_num AS fig_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS v FROM inventories GROUP BY set_num) m
      ON i.set_num = m.set_num AND i.version = m.v
),
-- explode: (root_set, inventory_id, multiplier)

    SELECT ts.set_num AS root_set, si.inventory_id, 1 AS mult
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN set_inv si ON si.set_num = ts.set_num

           COALESCE(nsi.inventory_id, fi.inventory_id),
           e.mult * x.qty

        UNION ALL
        SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS item, quantity AS qty, 'fig' AS kind FROM inventory_minifigs

    LEFT JOIN fig_inv fi ON x.kind = 'fig' AND fi.fig_num = x.item
)
```

```sql
        UNION ALL
        SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS item, quantity FROM inventory_minifigs
    ) x ON x.inventory_id = e.inv_id
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = x.item
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num FROM (
        SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) rn
        FROM inventories
    ) WHERE rn = 1
```

```sql
    SELECT SUM(ip.quantity) AS qty
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ci.set_num = '71837-1' AND ip.is_spare = false
),
-- explode nested sets and minifigs recursively
explode AS (
    -- anchor: children of 71837-1 (nested sets and minifigs)
    SELECT x.child AS item, x.qty AS qty
    FROM (
        SELECT ci.set_num AS parent, inv.set_num AS child, inv.quantity AS qty
        FROM current_inv ci
        JOIN inventory_sets inv ON inv.inventory_id = ci.id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ci.set_num AS parent, inv.fig_num AS child, inv.quantity AS qty
        FROM current_inv ci
        JOIN inventory_minifigs inv ON inv.inventory_id = ci.id
    ) x
    WHERE x.parent = '71837-1'
    UNION ALL
    -- recursive: children of items
    SELECT y.child, e.qty * y.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN (
        SELECT ci.set_num AS parent, inv.set_num AS child, inv.quantity AS qty
        FROM current_inv ci
        JOIN inventory_sets inv ON inv.inventory_id = ci.id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ci.set_num AS parent, inv.fig_num AS child, inv.quantity AS qty
        FROM current_inv ci
        JOIN inventory_minifigs inv ON inv.inventory_id = ci.id

    FROM explode e

    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Collectible Minifigures'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2014 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
),
current_edges AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty
    FROM u_composition u
    WHERE version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) FROM u_composition u2
        WHERE u2.parent_kind = u.parent_kind AND u2.parent_num = u.parent_num
    )
),
explode AS (
    SELECT ts.set_num AS root_set, e.child_kind, e.child_num, e.qty
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN current_edges e ON e.parent_kind = 'set' AND e.parent_num = ts.set_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT x.root_set, e.child_kind, e.child_num, x.qty * e.qty
    FROM explode x
    JOIN current_edges e ON e.parent_kind = x.child_kind AND e.parent_num = x.child_num
    WHERE x.child_kind IN ('set','minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM explode
WHERE child_kind = 'minifig';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
```

```sql
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN juniors j ON t.parent_id = j.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2016 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM juniors)
),
cur_ver AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS v
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
explode AS (
    SELECT ts.set_num AS root, c.child_kind, c.child_num, c.color_id, c.qty AS qty
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN cur_ver cv ON cv.parent_kind = 'set' AND cv.parent_num = ts.set_num
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_num = ts.set_num AND c.version = cv.v
    WHERE NOT (c.child_kind = 'part' AND c.is_spare)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.root, c.child_kind, c.child_num, c.color_id, e.qty * c.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN cur_ver cv ON cv.parent_kind = e.child_kind AND cv.parent_num = e.child_num
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind AND c.parent_num = e.child_num AND c.version = cv.v
    WHERE NOT (c.child_kind = 'part' AND c.is_spare)
),
per_set AS (
    SELECT root AS set_num, SUM(qty) AS parts
    FROM explode
    WHERE child_kind = 'part'
    GROUP BY root
)

FROM target_sets ts
LEFT JOIN per_set ps ON ps.set_num = ts.set_num;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- current inventory version per parent (set/minifig)
cur AS (
  SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS version
  FROM u_composition
  GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
-- explosion of each 2019 set's current inventory
expl AS (
  -- anchor: direct children of each 2019 set's current inventory
  SELECT s.set_num AS root_num,
         c.child_kind AS item_kind,
         c.child_num AS item_num,
         c.color_id,
         c.is_spare,
         c.qty::BIGINT AS qty
  FROM sets s
  JOIN cur k ON k.parent_kind = 'set' AND k.parent_num = s.set_num
  JOIN u_composition c
    ON c.parent_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_num = s.set_num AND c.version = k.version
  WHERE s.year = 2019

  UNION ALL

  -- recursive: expand nested sets and minifigs using their own current inventory
  SELECT e.root_num,
         c.child_kind,
         c.child_num,
         c.color_id,
         c.is_spare,
         (e.qty * c.qty)::BIGINT
  FROM expl e
  JOIN cur k ON k.parent_kind = e.item_kind AND k.parent_num = e.item_num
  JOIN u_composition c
    ON c.parent_kind = e.item_kind AND c.parent_num = e.item_num AND c.version = k.version
  WHERE e.item_kind IN ('set','minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM expl
WHERE item_kind = 'part'
  AND item_num = '3941'
  AND color_id = (SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Trans-Light Blue')
  AND is_spare = FALSE;
```

```sql
        NULL::INT AS color_id,
        iset.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    JOIN target_inventory ti ON iset.inventory_id = ti.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL

        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,

        im.fig_num AS fig_num,
        NULL::INT AS color_id,

    FROM inventory_minifigs im
```

```sql
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (set_num) id, set_num
    FROM inventories
    ORDER BY set_num, version DESC
),
nested_items AS (
    -- Anchor: the starting set
    SELECT 
        '43208-1' as item_num,
        1 as qty,
        'set' as item_type,
        0 as depth
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: find nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN iset.set_num
            WHEN im.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN im.fig_num
        END as item_num,
        ni.qty * COALESCE(iset.quantity, im.quantity),
        CASE 
            WHEN iset.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set'
            WHEN im.fig_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'minifig'
        END as item_type,
        ni.depth + 1
    FROM nested_items ni
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ni.item_num
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ni.item_type = 'set'
      AND (iset.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE theme_tree AS (

    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Racers'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id

    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2012
      AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)

-- Recursive explosion of set contents
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: direct inventory parts for each set
    SELECT 
        s.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM sets_2012 s
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(i2.version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = s.set_num)
      AND ip.is_spare = false

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        e.qty * sub.qty AS qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN (
        -- Nested sets
        SELECT 
            inv.set_num AS parent_set,
            ins.set_num AS child_set,
            ins.quantity AS qty
        FROM inventories inv
        JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.inventory_id = inv.id
        WHERE inv.version = (SELECT MAX(i3.version) FROM inventories i3 WHERE i3.set_num = inv.set_num)
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- Minifigs
        SELECT 
            inv.set_num AS parent_set,
            imf.fig_num AS child_set,
            imf.quantity AS qty
        FROM inventories inv
        JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = inv.id
        WHERE inv.version = (SELECT MAX(i4.version) FROM inventories i4 WHERE i4.set_num = inv.set_num)
```

```sql
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '21360-1'
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '21360-1')
),

-- Get the part category ID for 'Minifig Upper Body'
minifig_upper_body_cat AS (
    SELECT id FROM part_categories WHERE name = 'Minifig Upper Body'
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents: parts, nested sets, and minifigs
-- We track the multiplier from quantities along the path
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: start with the current inventory of set 21360-1
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        1.0 AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        '21360-1' AS item_id
    FROM current_inventory ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand nested sets and minifigs
    -- For nested sets: get their current inventory and multiply quantity
    -- For minifigs: get their inventory and multiply quantity
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN e.item_type = 'set' THEN (
                SELECT i.id 
                FROM inventories i 
                WHERE i.set_num = is2.set_num 
                AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = is2.set_num)
            )
            WHEN e.item_type = 'minifig' THEN (
                SELECT i.id 
                FROM inventories i 
                WHERE i.set_num = im.fig_num 
                AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
            )
        END AS inventory_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * CASE 
            WHEN e.item_type = 'set' THEN is2.quantity
            WHEN e.item_type = 'minifig' THEN im.quantity
        END AS qty_multiplier,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.item_type = 'set' THEN 'set'
            WHEN e.item_type = 'minifig' THEN 'set'  -- minifig inventory is treated like a set inventory for further nesting
        END AS item_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.item_type = 'set' THEN is2.set_num
            WHEN e.item_type = 'minifig' THEN im.fig_num

    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON e.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
    AND (is2.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL)
```

```sql
        id,

        version,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories

exploded_parts AS (
    -- Anchor: direct parts from set inventories (non-spare)
    SELECT 
        s.set_num as root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity as total_quantity
    FROM set_current_inventory s

        ep.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ep.total_quantity * ip.quantity as total_quantity
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = ep.root_set
    JOIN set_current_inventory sci ON sci.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = sci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE

        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,

    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (

    )
    JOIN set_current_inventory msci ON msci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = msci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
```

```sql
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, 1 AS quantity
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '42112-1' AND i.version = 1

    -- Anchor: start with the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        ci.quantity AS path_quantity,
        'set' AS item_type,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS part_num,
        NULL::INT AS color_id,
        (SELECT s.set_num FROM inventories i JOIN sets s ON i.set_num = s.set_num WHERE i.id = ci.inventory_id) AS set_num,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS fig_num
    FROM current_inventory ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        next_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        ec.path_quantity * COALESCE(is2.quantity, im.quantity) AS path_quantity,
        CASE WHEN is2.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set' ELSE 'minifig' END AS item_type,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS part_num,
        NULL::INT AS color_id,
        is2.set_num,
        im.fig_num
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN inventories i ON i.id = ec.inventory_id
    -- Nested sets: join to inventory_sets, then to the nested set's current inventory
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON is2.inventory_id = ec.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN inventories next_inv ON next_inv.set_num = is2.set_num

    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ec.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN inventories next_inv2 ON next_inv2.set_num = im.fig_num 
        AND next_inv2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory for a set or minifig
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.set_num,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.set_num ORDER BY i.version DESC) AS rn
    FROM inventories i
),
-- Recursive expansion of contents
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: start with set 45801-1's current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.inventory_id,
        1 AS quantity,
        'set' AS item_type,
        ci.set_num AS item_id,
        0 AS nesting_level
    FROM current_inventory ci
    WHERE ci.set_num = '45801-1' AND ci.rn = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Step: expand nested sets, minifigs, and their contents
    SELECT 
        ci2.inventory_id,
        e.quantity * COALESCE(is2.quantity, im.quantity) AS quantity,
        CASE WHEN is2.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set' ELSE 'minifig' END AS item_type,
        COALESCE(is2.set_num, im.fig_num) AS item_id,
        e.nesting_level + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON e.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id AND ci.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON ci.inventory_id = is2.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ci.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci2 ON 
        (is2.set_num IS NOT NULL AND ci2.set_num = is2.set_num) OR
        (im.fig_num IS NOT NULL AND ci2.set_num = im.fig_num)
    WHERE ci2.rn = 1 AND (is2.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL)
),
-- Get all inventory IDs in the explosion (including the root)
all_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT inventory_id, quantity, item_type, item_id, nesting_level
    FROM exploded
),
-- Parts from direct inventory listings (nesting_level = 0, i.e., the root set's own parts)
direct_parts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ip.quantity), 0) AS total
    FROM all_inventories ai
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ai.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id AND ci.rn = 1
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ai.nesting_level = 0 AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
),
-- Parts from nested items (nesting_level > 0)
nested_parts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ai.quantity * ip.quantity), 0) AS total
    FROM all_inventories ai
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ai.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id AND ci.rn = 1
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ai.nesting_level > 0 AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (np.total * 100.0) / NULLIF(dp.total + np.total, 0),
        2
    ) AS percentage_from_nested
FROM direct_parts dp, nested_parts np
```

```sql
    FROM u_composition
```

```sql
    JOIN set_current_version scv ON scv.set_num = s.set_num AND uc.version = scv.max_version
```

```sql
    FROM themes
    UNION ALL
```
```sql
    -- Recursive: find all descendants

    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON t.parent_id = th.id
```

```sql
    FROM themes
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL
),
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        th.id AS theme_id,
        th.name AS theme_name,
        COALESCE(tlt.id, th.id) AS top_level_id,
        COALESCE(tlt.name, th.name) AS top_level_name
    FROM themes th
    LEFT JOIN theme_hierarchy path ON th.id = path.id
    LEFT JOIN top_level_themes tlt ON path.parent_id = tlt.id
    -- For themes that are top-level themselves
    UNION
    SELECT 
        id AS theme_id,
        name AS theme_name,
        id AS top_level_id,
        name AS top_level_name
    FROM themes
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL
),
all_themes_mapped AS (
    -- Ensure every theme maps to exactly one top-level theme
    SELECT DISTINCT
        th.id AS theme_id,
        tlt.name AS top_level_name
    FROM themes th
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th_path ON th.id = th_path.id OR th.id = th_path.parent_id
    JOIN top_level_themes tlt ON 
        (th_path.id = tlt.id AND th.parent_id IS NULL) OR
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM theme_hierarchy th2 
            WHERE th2.id = th.id 
            AND th2.parent_id = tlt.id
        )
    UNION
    -- Direct mapping: for each theme, find its root
    SELECT 
        th.id AS theme_id,
        root.name AS top_level_name
    FROM themes th
    JOIN LATERAL (
        WITH RECURSIVE up AS (
            SELECT id, name, parent_id FROM themes WHERE id = th.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id 
            FROM themes t 
            JOIN up ON t.id = up.parent_id
        )
        SELECT name FROM up WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    ) root ON true
)
SELECT top_level_name
FROM (
    SELECT 
        tlt.name AS top_level_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num) AS set_count
    FROM top_level_themes tlt
    LEFT JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON tlt.id = th.id OR tlt.id = (
        WITH RECURSIVE down AS (
            SELECT id, parent_id FROM themes WHERE id = tlt.id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT t.id, t.parent_id 
            FROM themes t 
            JOIN down ON t.parent_id = down.id
        )
        SELECT id FROM down WHERE down.id = th.id
    )
    LEFT JOIN themes all_t ON all_t.id = COALESCE(th.id, tlt.id)
    LEFT JOIN sets s ON s.theme_id = all_t.id AND s.year = 2012
    GROUP BY tlt.name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num) > 0
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory version for each set/minifig
current_versions AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
-- Recursive expansion of set contents
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: direct children of set 10785-1 from its current inventory
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        c.qty,
        c.is_spare,
        1 AS depth
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN current_versions cv 
        ON c.parent_kind = cv.parent_kind 
        AND c.parent_num = cv.parent_num 
        AND c.version = cv.max_version
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'set' 
      AND c.parent_num = '10785-1'
      AND c.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        c.is_spare,
        e.depth + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition c
        ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind 
        AND c.parent_num = e.child_num
    JOIN current_versions cv
        ON c.parent_kind = cv.parent_kind
        AND c.parent_num = cv.parent_num
        AND c.version = cv.max_version
    WHERE e.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND c.is_spare = FALSE
),
-- Calculate totals
direct_parts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total
    FROM exploded
    WHERE depth = 1 AND child_kind = 'part'
),
nested_parts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total
    FROM exploded
    WHERE depth > 1 AND child_kind = 'part'
),
total_parts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total
    FROM exploded
    WHERE child_kind = 'part'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.total = 0 THEN 0 
            ELSE (n.total * 100.0 / t.total) 
        END, 
        2
    ) AS percentage_from_nested
FROM nested_parts n
CROSS JOIN total_parts t
```

```sql
        child_num,
        color_id,
        qty,
        -- Track whether this came from a nested set or minifig (not direct part)
        CASE WHEN child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_nested_path
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set' 
      AND parent_num = '71837-1'
      AND version = (SELECT version FROM current_version)
      AND is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        e.qty * c.qty as qty,
        CASE WHEN c.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig') THEN e.is_nested_path ELSE e.is_nested_path END as is_nested_path
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = CASE WHEN e.child_kind = 'set' THEN 'set' ELSE 'minifig' END
                        AND c.parent_num = e.child_num
                        AND c.is_spare = FALSE
    WHERE e.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
      AND c.version = (
          SELECT MAX(version) 
          FROM u_composition 
          WHERE parent_kind = c.parent_kind AND parent_num = c.parent_num
      )
),

-- Get all parts with their source classification
all_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        qty,
        -- A part is "direct" only if it came from the top level and child_kind was 'part'
        -- Otherwise it's from nested sets/minifigs
        CASE WHEN is_nested_path = 0 AND child_kind = 'part' THEN 'direct' ELSE 'nested' END as source
    FROM exploded
    WHERE child_kind = 'part'
)

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'nested' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(qty), 0),
        2
    ) as percentage_from_nested
FROM all_parts
```

```sql
        c.color_id,

        e.depth + 1,
        c.child_kind != 'part' as is_nested

                        AND c.parent_num = e.child_num
    WHERE e.child_kind != 'part'  -- only expand sets and minifigs
      AND c.version = (
          SELECT MAX(version) 
          FROM u_composition 
          WHERE parent_kind = c.parent_kind AND parent_num = c.parent_num
      )
      AND (c.is_spare = FALSE OR c.is_spare IS NULL)
),

-- Calculate totals
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN depth = 1 AND child_kind = 'part' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) as direct_parts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN depth > 1 OR (depth = 1 AND child_kind != 'part') THEN 
                 CASE WHEN child_kind = 'part' THEN qty ELSE 0 END 
            ELSE 0 END) as nested_parts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN child_kind = 'part' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) as total_parts
    FROM exploded
)

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        CASE WHEN total_parts = 0 THEN 0 
             ELSE 100.0 * nested_parts / total_parts 
        END, 
        2
    ) as percentage_from_nested
FROM totals
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current version of set 391114-1

    SELECT MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND parent_num = '391114-1'
),

-- Recursive explosion of all contents
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: direct children of set 391114-1 (current version)
    SELECT 
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.qty,
        uc.child_kind != 'part' AS is_nested  -- nested sets or minifigs
    FROM u_composition uc, current_version cv
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'set' 
      AND uc.parent_num = '391114-1'
      AND uc.version = cv.version
      AND uc.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode minifigs and nested sets
    SELECT 
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        e.qty * uc.qty AS qty,
        uc.child_kind != 'part' AS is_nested
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN (
        -- Get current version for each parent
        SELECT 
            parent_kind,
            parent_num,
            MAX(version) AS version
        FROM u_composition
        GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
    ) cv ON e.child_kind = cv.parent_kind AND e.child_num = cv.parent_num
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = cv.parent_kind 
                         AND uc.parent_num = cv.parent_num
                         AND uc.version = cv.version
    WHERE e.is_nested  -- only continue if current level is a container (set or minifig)
      AND uc.is_spare = FALSE
),

-- Sum quantities: direct parts vs nested contributions
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_nested THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS direct_parts_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_nested THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS nested_qty,
        SUM(qty) AS total_qty
    FROM exploded
)

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN total_qty = 0 THEN 0 
            ELSE (nested_qty * 100.0 / total_qty) 
        END, 
        2
    ) AS percentage_from_nested
FROM totals
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE theme_tree AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT id AS dark_brown_id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Dark Brown'

    SELECT '2431' AS part_num

    FROM sets s

),
-- Recursive explosion: start from sets in 2012, follow composition recursively
exploded AS (
    -- Anchor: direct children of 2012 sets from current inventory
    SELECT 
        s.set_num AS root_set,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        c.qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM sets_2012 s
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_num = s.set_num
    WHERE c.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM u_composition 
        WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND parent_num = s.set_num
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_num,
        c.color_id,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind AND c.parent_num = e.child_num
    WHERE e.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')

          SELECT MAX(version) 
          FROM u_composition 
          WHERE parent_kind = e.child_kind AND parent_num = e.child_num
      )
)
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Yellow'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
yellow_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2015
      AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
),
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
exploded_parts AS (
    -- Anchor: direct parts in current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.parent_num AS root_set,
        c.child_num AS part_num,
        c.color_id,
        c.qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = ci.parent_kind 
                        AND c.parent_num = ci.parent_num 
                        AND c.version = ci.version
    WHERE c.child_kind = 'part'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        ep.root_set,
        c.child_num AS part_num,
        c.color_id,
        ep.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        c.is_spare
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_num = ep.part_num
                         OR c.parent_kind = 'minifig' AND c.parent_num = ep.part_num
    WHERE ep.part_num NOT LIKE '87617'  -- stop recursing if we found our part (optimization)
      AND c.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig', 'part')
      AND c.version = (
          SELECT MAX(version) 
          FROM u_composition 
          WHERE parent_kind = c.parent_kind AND parent_num = c.parent_num
      )
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num) AS set_count
FROM yellow_sets s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    WHERE ep.root_set = s.set_num
      AND ep.part_num = '87617'
      AND ep.color_id = (SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Yellow')
      AND ep.is_spare = FALSE
)
```
